notes.title: New Game: Crazy World of Caleb
notes.notes:
Crazy World of Caleb is a new 2D Platformer in which Caleb will navigate through different levels to get his girl back, but it's not exactly as it seems.

Beware, if you lose all your lives then you have to start again. Yes the game has Perma-Death.

What are you waiting for? Get the game on Steam from the link below.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959760/Crazy_World_of_Caleb/
